# BB00683: Letter to the wife of the Bab, in Maku {.unnumbered}

Do not expect any assistance from thy brothers. They will not help; it is enough that they refrain from insults. Overlook their faults. Even Our enemies have not caused the like of what resulted from the acts of Siyyid 118 in Isfahan. God grant that when the light of thine eyes Mírza Aqa reacheth maturity, he will be thy help and support. O God! Preserve him from all the evil of the envious and the contumacious.
